2608.24555.title: StrokeGuard: A Multi-Agent Guided System for Prehospital Stroke Assessment
2608.24555.paper_summary: Prehospital stroke assessment aims to accurately identify stroke symptoms and make rapid decisions through standardized procedures within an extremely narrow time window, thereby saving valuable time for subsequent treatment. In clinical practice, FAST-based scales are widely used for prehospital stroke assessment by issuing instructions that guide subjects to perform specific actions to screen facial, arm, and speech functions. However, in home and community settings, non-clinical users often encounter challenges such as inaccurate descriptions, incomplete symptom observation, and difficult operational procedures, which may lead to inaccurate or biased assessment results. To address these challenges, this paper presents StrokeGuard: a multi-agent guided system designed for prehospital stroke assessment that makes mobile FAST screening more standardized and executable. Specifically, to overcome the limitations of traditional single-agent systems in terms of procedural fault tolerance and user guidance capability, StrokeGuard adopts a dual-channel agent mechanism that separates formal assessment (i.e., facial palsy, arm weakness, speech impairment) from procedural support (e.g., step prompts, error correction, and real-time feedback). It guides the assessment process through multi-agent collaboration, dual-channel interaction, state-machine control, and stage-local fallback recovery mechanisms. Stage-specific scoring is delegated to constrained pretrained video assessment modules, while evidence source records are integrated with structured report generation. The user evaluation uses MATES-9, an exploratory scale for measuring user experience in multistep AI-guided tasks. In a simulated prehospital scenario, StrokeGuard improves the MATES-9 total score over a paper FAST-style form by 10.83 points, corresponding to a 23.8% relative increase.
2608.24555.paper_summary_zh: 預醫療中風評估的目的是準確識別中風症狀並通過標準化程序在極其狹窄的時間窗口內迅速做出決策，從而為隨後的治療節省寶貴的時間。<lb/>在臨床實踐中，基於FAST的量表被廣泛用於預醫療中風評估，通過發出指示來引導受試者執行特定動作，以篩查面部、手臂和語音功能。<lb/>然而，在家庭和社區環境中，非臨床用戶經常面臨挑戰，例如不準確的描述、不完整的症狀觀察和困難的操作程序，這可能導致不準確或偏頗的評估結果。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，本文提出了StrokeGuard：一個多代理引導系統，旨在進行預醫療中風評估，使移動FAST篩查更加標準化和可執行。<lb/>具體而言，為了克服傳統單一代理系統在程序容錯和用戶引導能力方面的限制，StrokeGuard採用了雙通道代理機制，將正式評估（即面部癱瘓、手臂無力、語言障礙）與程序支持（例如步驟提示、錯誤修正和實時反饋）分開。<lb/>它通過多代理協作、雙通道互動、狀態機控制和階段本地回退恢復機制引導評估過程。<lb/>階段特定的評分委託給受限的預訓練視頻評估模塊，同時證據來源記錄與結構化報告生成相結合。<lb/>用戶評估使用MATES-9，這是一個用於測量多步驟AI引導任務中用戶體驗的探索性量表。<lb/>在模擬的預醫療場景中，StrokeGuard使MATES-9總分比紙質FAST風格表單提高了10.83分，對應於23.8%的相對增長。
